budget_check.what_it_is: the enumerability condition the v2 rule declines to cap per type: the WORST per-intent card set against the arm's own measured headroom. KC-S1b's measured worst prompt envelope is 10,006 tokens in a 16,384-token slot at -np 4 (its own prompt-fit receipt and the KU-S3 preregistration section 5), so a card set has 6,378 tokens to live in

mf10-cardability-v2.mixed: everything else, and every type with no DEV gold to cover

roles.coverage: decides -- a card pays exactly when DEV gold is inside it
roles.reuse: disqualifies, but only where the ratio is estimable (>= 50 TRAIN mentions)
roles.size: checked, not capped: the enumerability question is asked of the per-intent card SET against the arm's own measured prompt headroom, below

mf10-cardability-v2.status: OPERATIVE -- the views of question 2 are built on this

mf10-novelty-v1.defect: the novelty ratio is a RATE ESTIMATE bounded from below by 1 / mentions, so a rare type cannot have a low one: alarm_type has four distinct surface forms and nine TRAIN mentions, and this rule calls it open. The defect is in the statistic, not in the corpus, and it is reported rather than repaired in silence
mf10-novelty-v1.status: DECLARED BEFORE THE READ, and reported because it is WRONG
